question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**help**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is butterflies.
 
• **In blank 3 a word will be used that will assist them to blend into the surrounding.**
 
• **"Help" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. **
 
• It is a verb that means to give assistance or support to someone in need.(मदद)
 
 
• Example: "The volunteers came to help the victims of the natural disaster."
 
 

​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "rescue", is also a verb that means to save someone from danger or difficulty.(बचाव)
 
• Option 3, "improve", is a verb that means to make something better.(सुधार)
 
• Option 4, "save", is a verb that means to keep someone or something from harm or danger. (बचाना)
